ruleDefinitions.name: RTCore Suspicious Service Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the installation of RTCore service. Which could be an indication of Micro-Star MSI Afterburner vulnerable driver abuse Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ServiceName

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND ServiceName = "RTCore64")
